items.question: How many years is the operating licence that FANR issued for Unit 2 of the Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant?
items.fact: FANR issued 60-year operating licence for Barakah Unit 2

items.question: What is the combined capacity of the four reactor units at the Barakah Nuclear Energy Plant?
items.fact: Barakah's four units have combined capacity of 5.6 GW
